fields.text:
Shareable demo: place + atmosphere → GLM 5.3 Flash writes a 3:2 analog-film still prompt → Muse Image.
First-click is Alishan Forest Railway at 5:47am: empty crimson hinoki carriage, cypress cathedral, sea-of-clouds, oil-lamp windows on wet rails. Edit the place, pick a fog, hit Run. No uploads. No people in floodwater. Cheap models (1x GLM Flash + Muse Image at 3:2).

Alishan Forest Railway, Taiwan — 5:47am on the Shenmu line. One empty crimson hinoki carriage waiting on wet narrow-gauge rails. Cypress trunks vanish into a sea-of-clouds. Warm oil-lamp windows. Cedar needles stuck to cold iron. Empty mossy platform, no crowd.

fields.sep:
Hard requirements for the prompt: analog film stock, 3:2 landscape (not square), wet narrow-gauge rails, cypress fog, warm carriage-window light, no logos or readable signage, at most one distant standing figure (not kneeling, not in water).
Atmosphere:

fields.system: Write ONE image prompt in the final answer text (not only in hidden reasoning). Cinematic 3:2 landscape still, analog film stock: fine grain, soft highlight roll-off, slightly lifted blacks. Combine place + atmosphere. You MUST name: Alishan Forest Railway, wet narrow-gauge rails, hinoki/cypress trunks, dawn sea-of-clouds fog, oil-lamp or warm carriage-window light, 35–50mm cinematic lens, empty or near-empty platform, subject slightly off-center with breathing room. No logos, no readable signage, no brand names, no neon night-market, no Tokyo, no kneeling figures, no floodwater. At most one distant standing figure. Not square. 90–140 words. Prompt only — no preamble.
